title: satureja serpyllifolia subsp. barbata
intro: Satureja serpyllifolia subsp. barbata, commonly known as woodland savory or mountain savory, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential remedy for various ailments. Its therapeutic actions include reducing pain and inflammation, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial and antifungal properties. The bioactive constituents of Satureja serpyllifolia subsp. barbata include thymol, carvacrol, and other monoterpenic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
